title: Marked
description: Marked is a PvP-focused bounty plugin where players can place and claim bounties, with a hover-only GUI displaying real player skulls of the most wanted targets. It supports Vault rewards, anonymous bounties, and integrates cleanly with PlaceholderAPI.
body:
🔫 **Marked** is a Minecraft PvP bounty plugin that allows players to place and claim bounties on each other. When a player is killed, the killer automatically receives the posted reward. A GUI displays the top 10 most-wanted players using real player skulls with hoverable bounty info.

✅ What it does:
Lets players place bounties on others using Vault currency

Automatically rewards killers when bounty targets are slain

Provides a GUI leaderboard of top bounties using skulls + hover info

💡 Why download it:
Adds meaningful PvP goals and risk/reward to survival servers

Encourages rivalry, bounty events, and emergent gameplay

Lightweight, immersive, and easy to use — no complex setup required

⚠️ Critical info:
Requires Vault for economy support

GUI is hover-only; no click interactions

Compatible with PlaceholderAPI for scoreboard/chat integration

Once you're **Marked**, you're never safe.
